name: jump_king
mechanic: vertical precision platformer; hold D to charge a jump and release to launch in a fixed arc (LEFT/RIGHT held while charging sets direction), no air control once airborne; walls bounce the jumper; a missed landing falls back down multiple screens, losing progress; score = highest platform height reached this episode

name: hoplite
mechanic: turn-based tactics roguelike on a hex grid; one action per turn, then all demons move; the six hex directions map to LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN/LEFT+D/RIGHT+D and D alone waits; moving past or next to a demon stabs it; reach the stairs to descend to the next procedurally generated depth; lava tiles kill; score = demons killed + 10 per depth descended

name: hyper_light_drifter
mechanic: top-down action; arrows move the drifter through procedurally arranged enemy rooms, D dashes a fixed distance in the held direction (i-frames while dashing), sword slash triggers automatically on enemies in melee range; enemies telegraph then shoot projectiles; clearing a room opens the next; score = kills + 5 per room cleared

name: cave_story
mechanic: side-scrolling platform shooter; LEFT/RIGHT run, D jumps, gun auto-fires in the facing direction, UP aims upward; kills drop weapon energy that levels the gun up (more damage), taking a hit drops one weapon level and costs health; reach the door at the end of the cave to advance; score = kills + weapon energy collected + 20 per cave cleared

name: zelda
mechanic: top-down dungeon crawler; arrows move through a procedurally connected grid of rooms, D swings the sword in the facing direction; enemies roam rooms and deal contact damage, hearts restore health; collect keys to open locked doors and rupees for score; find and defeat the boss to clear the dungeon; score = kills + rupees + 5 per key used + 50 for the boss
